table.name: TLGNC_TRSP_ZONE_POLYGON
table.description: A transport zone is geographically defined by 1 or several polygons which define the area(s) of the zone. Such polygons can overlap with polygons of other areas. If this happens, the one with the highest z-index is taken.

column.name: TRSP_ZONE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_trsp_zone_bs. Transport Zone to which this polygon belongs. Examples: CH-A00, CH-A01, DE-A00, ...

column.name: COLOR_RGB
column.description: Color code of the polygon (area) in RGB notation, hexadecimal. FF0000=red, FFFF00=yellow, etc.

column.name: Z_INDEX
column.description: Z-Index of the polygon. Higher Z-Index means 'lies on top' and gets higher priority if polygons overlap. Is ignored, as long as polygons do not overlap.
